description: Issue #35, part 4V lesson 04-25 (RPG cycle, control levels L1/L2, fixed-form RPG IV, CRTBNDRPG). Compiles the two shipped samples V0425A (port of R0410A: primary file JUCHUL1, L1 on JUTOK) and V0425D (port of R0413A: primary file ZAIKOM, CHAIN SHOHIM, COMP LO, LOWSTOCK) and four exercise answers (solutions/04-25, scratch member names X425*): X425E two levels L1/L2 plus LR, X425DL (V0425F) COMP with LO and EQ, X425C the V0425A source WITHOUT K in column 34, X425B the L1 lines placed BEFORE the detail lines (a NEGATIVE example: its compile is expected to fail; the RNF id is read from the event file). OPTION(*EVENTF) puts the compile event file member of each into VFYEVF (copied from EVFEVENT in &LIB, as part04v-23run does). The I spec layout of V0425A (field name col 49, control level col 63) is the one layout no verified sample covers, so a compile failure of V0425A is a real finding, not a harness error. RUN: every program only reads (JUCHUL1, ZAIKOM, SHOHIM), the printed lines are read from this connection result run section (per docs/probes.md, CPYSPLF of QSYSPRT is not used). Expected: V0425A 8 detail lines with 6 SUBTOTAL lines (counts C00001=2, C00002=1, C00003=2, C00004=1, C00005=1, C00006=1); V0425D 6 lines in ZASHO order with LOWSTOCK only on P00002 and P00005; X425C arrival order so about 8 SUBTOTAL lines. Nothing is verified until this batch has run. PRECONDITION (not checkable inside a manifest, so read it in the output): the library already holds the DBVER 1 sample database (ZAIKOM P00002 = 3); CHKLNG prints TXLEGLNG if it exists. The library list is reset first (RMVLIBLE then ADDLIBLE POSITION(*FIRST) of &LIB, the pattern of part04v-23run). This batch does not change the legacy language of the library (no TXLEGACY call), so there is nothing to restore except the sample data: TXRESET runs before and after, and VFYSTK records ZAIKOM snapshots (RESET0, AFTER). No call can hang (no record lock, no display file); the compile of X425B is last among the compiles only by the order of the member list.

steps.label: RMLIB
steps.cmd: RMVLIBLE LIB(&LIB)

steps.label: ADLIB
steps.cmd: ADDLIBLE LIB(&LIB) POSITION(*FIRST)

steps.label: DSPLIBL
steps.cmd: DSPLIBL OUTPUT(*PRINT)

steps.label: CHKLNG
steps.cmd: DSPDTAARA DTAARA(&LIB/TXLEGLNG) OUTPUT(*PRINT)

steps.label: CHGTYPES
steps.cmd:
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0425A) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0425D) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(X425E) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(X425DL) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(X425C) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(X425B) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: CRTEVF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYEVF) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYEVF) RCDLEN(300) TEXT('compile event capture'))

steps.label: CLREVF
steps.cmd: CLRPFM FILE(&LIB/VFYEVF)

steps.label: CRTSTK
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFYSTK (TAG VARCHAR(10), ZASHO CHAR(6), ZASU DECIMAL(7, 0))') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: RESET0
steps.cmd: &LIB/TXRESET LIB(&LIB)

steps.label: SNRESET0
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYSTK SELECT ''RESET0'', ZASHO, ZASU FROM &LIB/ZAIKOM') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CPV0425A
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/V0425A) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(V0425A) OPTION(*EVENTF) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: EVV0425A
steps.cmd: CPYF FROMFILE(&LIB/EVFEVENT) FROMMBR(V0425A) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYEVF) MBROPT(*ADD) FMTOPT(*NOCHK)

steps.label: CPV0425D
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/V0425D) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(V0425D) OPTION(*EVENTF) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: EVV0425D
steps.cmd: CPYF FROMFILE(&LIB/EVFEVENT) FROMMBR(V0425D) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYEVF) MBROPT(*ADD) FMTOPT(*NOCHK)

steps.label: CPX425E
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/X425E) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(X425E) OPTION(*EVENTF) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: EVX425E
steps.cmd: CPYF FROMFILE(&LIB/EVFEVENT) FROMMBR(X425E) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYEVF) MBROPT(*ADD) FMTOPT(*NOCHK)

steps.label: CPX425DL
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/X425DL) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(X425DL) OPTION(*EVENTF) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: EVX425DL
steps.cmd: CPYF FROMFILE(&LIB/EVFEVENT) FROMMBR(X425DL) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYEVF) MBROPT(*ADD) FMTOPT(*NOCHK)

steps.label: CPX425C
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/X425C) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(X425C) OPTION(*EVENTF) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: EVX425C
steps.cmd: CPYF FROMFILE(&LIB/EVFEVENT) FROMMBR(X425C) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYEVF) MBROPT(*ADD) FMTOPT(*NOCHK)

steps.label: CPX425B
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/X425B) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(X425B) OPTION(*EVENTF) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: EVX425B
steps.cmd: CPYF FROMFILE(&LIB/EVFEVENT) FROMMBR(X425B) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYEVF) MBROPT(*ADD) FMTOPT(*NOCHK)

steps.label: RUNV0425A
steps.cmd: CALL PGM(&LIB/V0425A)

steps.label: RUNV0425D
steps.cmd: CALL PGM(&LIB/V0425D)

steps.label: RUNX425E
steps.cmd: CALL PGM(&LIB/X425E)

steps.label: RUNX425DL
steps.cmd: CALL PGM(&LIB/X425DL)

steps.label: RUNX425C
steps.cmd: CALL PGM(&LIB/X425C)

steps.label: SNAFTER
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYSTK SELECT ''AFTER'', ZASHO, ZASU FROM &LIB/ZAIKOM') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: RESET1
steps.cmd: &LIB/TXRESET LIB(&LIB)

steps.sql: SELECT TAG, ZASHO, ZASU FROM &LIB/VFYSTK ORDER BY TAG, ZASHO
